verdict.rationale: Teams supports building bots/agents and Copilot agents that can run autonomously (agent slash commands, Graph API automation of teams/channels/messages, webhooks/connectors for background triggers), but this requires developer setup via the Toolkit CLI rather than a simple end-user 'set up an automation' experience like a no-code workflow builder. Missing for 10: evidence of a simple end-user-facing automation/workflow builder (e.g., Power Automate-style triggers within Teams UI), independent confirmation that these agents/bots run reliably unattended in production, and any hands-on validation of autonomous background execution.
